gurditta.hi: गुरदित्ता, इस आरतीके कवि, जो इसमें अपना नाम देते हैं
gurditta.en: Gurditta, the poet of this āratī, who names himself in it

indirā.en: Indirā, the Ekādaśī of the dark fortnight of Āśvina

ramā.en: Ramā, the Ekādaśī of the dark fortnight of Kārttika

yoginī.en: Yoginī, the Ekādaśī of the dark fortnight of Āṣāḍha

गुरदित्ता.en: Gurditta, the poet of this āratī
